components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled teal action for the main task on a surface.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: #146c60; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #146c60; border-radius: 5px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; font: 500 14px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #0d594f; border-color: #0d594f; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #277e71; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { filter: brightness(.94); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined surface action for secondary tasks.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #202b2b; border: 1px solid #e3e8e7; border-radius: 5px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; font: 500 14px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #f1f5f4; border-color: #667171; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #277e71; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { filter: brightness(.94); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact single-line field with a clear theme-colored focus outline.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; max-width: 430px; color: #202b2b; font: 500 14px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 43px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid #e3e8e7; border-radius: 5px; background: #ffffff; color: #202b2b; font: 400 14px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #667171; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #277e71; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Link
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 14px; border-radius: 5px; background: #e5f0ed; color: #146c60; font: 500 14px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: #f1f5f4; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #277e71; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: File Row
components.description: Flat file listing row with aligned size metadata.
components.css: .ds-file-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 116px; align-items: center; min-height: 59px; column-gap: 16px; padding: 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e3e8e7; color: #202b2b; font: 400 14px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background 140ms ease-out; } .ds-file-name { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-file-size { color: #667171; text-align: right; font-size: 13px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-file-row:hover { background: #f1f5f4; } .ds-file-row:focus-within { background: #f1f5f4; }

narrative.overview:
This system gives files the main visual weight. A slim header and compact navigation frame a broad working area; filenames sit in aligned rows, with thin separators doing the grouping. Neutral surfaces and a single muted teal accent keep routine file work calm and familiar.

The system uses system sans-serif type, small radii and brief state transitions. Light and dark themes share the same roles; the theme follows the operating system unless the user chooses one manually. This is a prototype direction pending user review, not approval of Sylux's production design system.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet neutral planes with teal reserved for primary and active states.
Rows, separators and navigation carry structure instead of enclosing cards.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep teal for primary actions, links and current locations; use neutral surfaces for the rest of the file workspace.

dos: Do keep file names visually dominant and actions grouped in the toolbar or row menu.
Do use teal for primary actions and the current location.
Do keep focus outlines visible and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do let neutral borders and surfaces establish grouping.
donts: Don't wrap the main file workspace in a large enclosing card.
Don't add promotional sign-in copy or unsupported capacity claims.
Don't use shadows on ordinary resting surfaces.
